dossier.candidate: Digital products, content & affiliate (Etsy/Gumroad digital downloads, courses, YouTube/TikTok/Instagram, SEO affiliate sites incl. the owner's existing Canadian tool price-comparison site)
dossier.summary:
VERDICT: this is a poor primary income plan for the next 30–60 days, though it could be a low-cost side bet. Every monetization gate I found has a threshold or a clock that a brand-new account cannot clear in 30–60 days, and the per-sale economics need large volume.

- YouTube ads: you need 1,000 subscribers plus either 4,000 watch hours in 12 months or 10M Shorts views in 90 days. For new applicants from 1 Feb 2027, this doubles to 8,000 hours or 20M Shorts views.
- TikTok Creator Rewards: available in Canada, but only with 10,000 followers, 100,000 views in the last 30 days, and videos over 1 minute.
- Instagram: bonuses are invite-only. Subscriptions need about 10,000 followers (third-party source).
- Amazon Associates: Tools & Home Improvement pays about 3%. The account closes if it does not refer 3 qualifying sales within 180 days.
- Etsy: fees for Canadian sellers take roughly 10% of each sale plus fixed fees, and 12–15% more when Offsite Ads applies.
- Google: since 2024 its spam policy targets 'scaled content abuse' (mass-produced low-value pages, including AI-made ones). Third-party reports say the March 2026 core update and the August 2026 spam update hit AI-scaled and thin affiliate sites.
- The owner's existing repo shows 0 of 54 tracked products with a live price. Every entry is a 'checkManually' search link with price 0. As it stands the site has no unique value, which is the profile that thin-affiliate enforcement targets.
- I found no sourced evidence that a new creator or site reaches CAD 5,000/month within 1–3 months.

Research limitation, stated for transparency: WebFetch was blocked by the egress proxy for every domain tried (support.google.com, associates.amazon.ca, tiktok.com, help.etsy.com, developers.google.com, blog.youtube, ppc.land, gsqi.com, jonescosman.com). The session-wide WebSearch budget (200 calls, shared with other agents) ran out after 10 searches. So every fact below comes from search-result snippets and the search tool's summaries of them, not from pages I read in full. Items marked 'not found' were not researched because of this. Treat all figures as needing a check on the official page before anyone acts on them.
dossier.time_to_first_revenue:
No sourced data was found on how long a new Etsy shop, affiliate site or creator takes to make a first sale. That remains 'not found'. What the sourced gates imply:

- YouTube ad revenue: impossible until 1,000 subscribers and 4,000 watch hours (or 10M Shorts views in 90 days) are reached. Sources: https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/72851?hl=en&co=GENIE.Platform%3DAndroid and https://vidiq.com/blog/post/youtube-partner-program-guide/. From 1 Feb 2027 new applicants need 8,000 hours or 20M Shorts views: https://tbreak.com/youtube-partner-program-8000-watch-hours/
- TikTok Creator Rewards: impossible until 10,000 followers and 100,000 views in the last 30 days. Sources: https://www.tiktok.com/creator-academy/en/article/creator-rewards-program and https://ttcalculator.net/learn/creator-fund-countries/
- Amazon.ca Associates: commission is earned per qualifying purchase. The account is closed if it has fewer than 3 qualifying sales within 180 days: https://affiliate-program.amazon.com/help/node/topic/G7MJTPEP9NC3YKMG. Amazon.ca payout timing: not found.
- Etsy digital downloads: products can be listed as soon as the human opens and verifies a shop. Time to first sale and payout schedule: not found.

ESTIMATE, not sourced: first small dollars (tens of CAD) from Etsy or affiliate links are plausible within 2–6 weeks. This rests only on the fact that listing or linking has no follower threshold. Meaningful income (CAD 1,000+/month) within 60 days has no supporting evidence.

pricing_facts.fact: YouTube Partner Program (full ad revenue sharing) requires 1,000 subscribers plus either 4,000 valid public watch hours on long-form videos in the last 12 months or 10 million valid public Shorts views in the last 90 days. The two pathways never combine. Other requirements: live in a YPP country, no active Community Guidelines strikes, and 2-Step Verification turned on.
Same 2026 thresholds (1,000 subs + 4,000 hours / 12 months or 10M Shorts views / 90 days), confirmed by a third-party 2026 guide.

From 1 Feb 2027, new YPP applicants need 8,000 qualified watch hours in the last 365 days or 20M qualified Shorts views in the last 90 days, plus 1,000 subscribers. Channels already in YPP are not affected for entry. Fan Funding and shopping entry thresholds are unchanged. Existing members need 10M Shorts views per 90 days to keep earning Shorts ad revenue. The change was reported in August 2026.
Business Standard also reports the YPP threshold doubling from 1 Feb 2027 (article URL dated 2026-08-11).

TikTok Creator Rewards Program: Canada is listed as an eligible country in 2026. Requirements are 10,000 followers, 100,000 views in the last 30 days, age 18+, original videos over 1 minute, and a Personal account in good standing. Duets, Stitches, Photo Mode and sponsored content do not qualify. These details come from third-party summaries; the official Creator Academy page could not be opened.
Third-party 2026 list of TikTok Creator Rewards countries that includes Canada.

Instagram in Canada (third-party sources): Subscriptions are supported, need about 10,000+ followers and are priced at $4.99–$49.99/month. Gifts on Reels need 500 followers. Bonuses are invite-only and vary by country. All features require a Professional account and age 18+.

Amazon Associates: Tools & Home Improvement is in the 3% commission tier. Home improvement and furniture were cut from 8% to 3% in April 2020. Caveat: this source describes the Amazon.com schedule. The Amazon.ca Commission Income Schedule (https://associates.amazon.ca/help/node/topic/GRXPHT8U84RAYDXZ) could not be opened, so the exact Amazon.ca rate for tools is not verified.
Amazon Associates: accounts that have not referred 3 qualifying purchases within 180 days of sign-up are closed. A closed Associates ID cannot be reinstated, but you can reapply for a new ID.

The Amazon.ca Associates Program Operating Agreement and Program Policies were updated effective April 14, 2026. For a purchase to qualify, the product must be shipped, streamed or downloaded, and paid for within 180 days.

Etsy 2026 fees: $0.20 listing fee per item (charged again each time an item sells and renews), 6.5% transaction fee on the total including shipping, a country-specific payment processing fee, and a possible 15% Offsite Ads fee.

Etsy fees for a Canadian seller: listing fee about US$0.20, 6.5% transaction fee, and payment processing of about 3% + C$0.25. Etsy charges GST/HST on its fees at the seller's provincial rate: 5% in AB/BC/MB/SK/QC per the source, 13% HST in Ontario.
Etsy's Regulatory Operating Fee for Canada is 0.50% of item price plus shipping, effective June 22, 2026. The search summary noted conflicting rates in older 2026 sources.
Etsy Offsite Ads become mandatory once a shop exceeds $10,000 in annual sales, at a 12% fee (15% for smaller shops that stay opted in).
Gumroad fees, Etsy digital-download category data, and course-platform fees: not found (search budget exhausted).

cost_facts.fact: Etsy listing fee: $0.20 per listing, charged again on each sale and renewal.
Etsy payment processing in Canada: about 3% + C$0.25 per order.
Etsy charges GST/HST on its seller fees based on the seller's province (13% HST in Ontario).
Etsy Regulatory Operating Fee for Canada: 0.50% (effective June 22, 2026).
Joining YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and Amazon Associates costs nothing (no fee found in any source). The real cost is the owner's time before any monetization threshold is met.

The existing repo (Next.js site, GitHub Actions scraper, browser extension) is already built. On 2026-09-23, 0 of the 54 products in public/cache/index.json had a live price; every entry is a store search link with price 0 and checkManually=true. It has a hardcoded Amazon tag, canadiantool-20.
Domain and hosting costs, and paid-ad costs for promoting digital products: not found in this session.

earnings_evidence.claim: Creators report $50 to $500 per month in extra income from Instagram Reels Gifts. This is a creator-reported figure repeated in a blog, not platform data.
Tools & Home Improvement commission is 3% on Amazon Associates (Amazon.com schedule; Amazon.ca not verified). So every CAD 100 of referred tool sales earns about CAD 3.

Sites that published hundreds or thousands of AI-generated pages without editorial oversight reportedly lost 50–80% of traffic in the March 2026 core update. This is an agency claim; no underlying dataset was seen.

Case studies on Google's August 2026 spam update cover scaled content abuse, AI content, programmatic content and thin affiliate sites. Only the title and summary were seen; the page could not be opened.
Users on Quora report Amazon affiliate accounts closed for no sales within 180 days, meaning new sites failed to produce even 3 qualifying sales in 6 months.
Typical time for a new creator or niche site to reach $1,000/month, and verified earnings of new creators in months 1–3: NOT FOUND in this session (search budget exhausted, page fetches blocked).

dossier.path_to_5k_math:
All figures are ESTIMATES built from the sourced rates above. Assumptions that have no source are marked (ASSUMPTION).

(1) Amazon.ca affiliate on tools at 3%: ESTIMATE: CAD 5,000 / 0.03 = CAD 166,667 of referred sales per month. With an average referred order of CAD 120 (ASSUMPTION), that is 166,667 / 120 = about 1,389 orders a month, or about 46 a day. At a click-to-purchase conversion of 5% (ASSUMPTION), it needs about 27,800 outbound clicks a month. The existing site currently shows 0 live prices, and a brand-new domain getting that traffic in 60 days has no evidence behind it.

(2) Etsy digital download priced at C$10: percentage fees are 6.5% + about 3% + 0.5% ROF = 10%, or C$1.00. Fixed fees are C$0.25 processing plus about C$0.28 listing (US$0.20; the exchange rate is an ASSUMPTION, not sourced). Net is about C$10 − 1.00 − 0.25 − 0.28 = C$8.47 before HST on fees and before any ads.
- C$5,000 / 8.47 = about 590 sales a month, or about 20 a day.
- At C$25: net is about 25 − 2.50 − 0.25 − 0.28 = C$21.97, so about 228 sales a month, or about 7.6 a day.
- If 15% Offsite Ads applies to a sale, the C$25 net falls by C$3.75 to about C$18.22, which needs about 275 sales a month.

(3) YouTube ads: can't be computed. RPM for a Canadian tools channel was not found, and a new channel has to reach 1,000 subscribers + 4,000 hours first. The 4,000 hours equal 240,000 minutes; at a 5-minute average view (ASSUMPTION) that is 48,000 long-form views before any ad dollar.

(4) TikTok Creator Rewards: can't be computed. Payout per qualified view was not found, and the gate is 10,000 followers + 100,000 views in 30 days.

(5) A mix, e.g. C$2,500 Etsy + C$2,500 affiliate: ESTIMATE: about 114 Etsy sales at C$21.97 plus CAD 83,333 of referred Amazon sales.

Conclusion: every route to CAD 5,000/month needs volumes a new account has no sourced evidence of reaching in 60 days. ESTIMATE: realistic 60-day outcome is CAD 0–500/month. This is not sourced; it is inferred from the gating thresholds.

Google's guidance on generative-AI content (an official page seen in search results; its full text could not be opened).

dossier.score_rationale:
**Speed 3:** Etsy listings and affiliate links can go live within days, since there is no follower gate. But YouTube, TikTok and Instagram payouts are gated by thresholds (1k subs + 4k hours; 10k followers + 100k views in 30 days) that new accounts can't realistically clear in 30 days. No sourced time-to-first-sale data was found.

**Probability of CAD 5k/month 1:** The sourced economics need about CAD 166,667/month in referred Amazon tool sales at 3%, or about 230–590 Etsy sales a month. I found no evidence of new accounts reaching that in 60 days, and several enforcement and threshold headwinds point the other way. The existing site has 0 live prices.

**Capital-light 9:** Almost no cash outlay (Etsy at US$0.20 per listing, free platform sign-ups). It loses a point because the owner must live on savings while revenue is near zero.

**AI leverage 7:** The AI can build nearly all digital assets: products, copy, the site, scripts, calculators. The human must still verify accounts, appear on camera or post, and review content. Google's scaled-content policy caps how far pure AI mass production can safely go.

**Low risk 7:** No physical or legal hazard, and small financial outlay. The risks are opportunity cost, account closures (the Amazon 180-day rule), algorithm or penalty exposure, and the fact that this dossier's facts could not be checked on full official pages because fetches were blocked.

**Recommendation from the evidence:** use this only as a low-cost side bet on top of a faster-cash primary business. If used, repurpose the existing tool site into genuinely original, human-reviewed Canadian comparison content rather than scaled AI pages.

verification.verdict: ELIMINATE as the primary 30–60-day income plan; at most keep as an optional side bet of 5 hours or less a week. Reasons: (1) The dossier's own sourced gates (YPP, TikTok and Instagram thresholds; 3% tool commission; Etsy fees of about 10% plus fixed and HST) require volumes (hundreds of Etsy sales a month, or roughly CAD 60k–170k of referred sales a month) that no evidence shows a new account reaching in 60 days. (2) None of those numbers could be confirmed on an official page in two separate research passes, so even the downside math is unverified. (3) The owner's only existing asset is weaker than described: index.json shows 0 live prices since 2026-08-08, the only non-zero prices are 5-month-stale Walmart figures, and the Amazon price scraper uses a spoofed User-Agent, which may conflict with Associates terms (unverified). (4) Payout timing is not found, so even a first sale may not become cash inside 30 days. Scores are down on speed (first cash within 30 days unlikely, payout lag unknown), AI leverage (on-camera work, account verification and Google scaled-content limits leave real work with the human), and low risk (Associates-closure and scraping-terms exposure, stale-price accuracy, opportunity cost). Pursue a faster-cash service business as the primary plan.
